scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compute Shannon entropy of sixteen-symbol local 5x5 image neighborhoods
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: H=log2(total)-sum_k(count_k*log2(count_k))/total, with zero-count contribution defined as zero
scientific_intent.discretization: 131x97 images with truncated boundary windows; random seed123, constant7, and sixteen-symbol spatial pattern
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: 38121 finite Float32 output entropies versus independent Float64 probability formula, error<1e-5, entropy in[0,4] and constant-field zero; all five full artifacts compared to both GPU refs
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Three complete 131x97 images including partial 16x16 edge blocks; each neighborhood at most25 samples
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 lookup table and accumulation/log2, exact Int32 bin counts. Zero-probability limit essential; original baseline omitted it and produces NaNs.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Local information/texture analysis of quantized images; generic source-backed entropy operator, no particular imaging dataset or physical application attributed.
scientific_intent.description: Complete optimized native local entropy operator, including image boundaries and all sixteen histogram bins. A genuine untimed native baseline probe independently exposes the separate baseline NaN defect; that variant is excluded from the measured equivalence contract.
scientific_intent.provenance: Source defines 5x5/sixteen-symbol entropy and optimized lookup formulation. Original baseline and CPU reference compute 0*log2(0); original fabs(NaN)>tol test cannot reject it. Untouched optimized kernel is finite and independently verified.
